body: As I glance in the shop window, my reflection stumbles into the shop. My eyes widen in dismay. My mind starts racing with indignation, and my impulse is to confront and demand. I notice the reflection glancing around, seemingly oblivious to the lag. I think to myself, "This is ridiculous! Why are they so late?"
